messages:
Anya: Morning — quick consolidation ask for Tue SRE interviews. We currently have three 50m panels back-to-back (09:00, 10:00, 11:00). Can we collapse into two panels + 15m buffer and confirm who will scribe/debrief?

Anya: Current roster:
```
09:00 - Panel A: Mike, Olivia, Samir
10:00 - Panel B: Jen, Anya, Rahul
11:00 - Panel C: Priya, Casey, Mike
```

Anya: Prefer to merge A+C into a single 10:00 slot (keeping diversity of interviewers) and keep one early panel. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

Mike: Fine with merge but I need to move off the 09:00 slot (conflict). I can cover 10:00 or 11:00 though.

Olivia: I can scribe if we keep 10:00 as the merged slot. Happy to take notes and submit debrief within 30m. :white_check_mark:

Samir: Heads up — rubric 2.1 (system design weight) was bumped to 40% for SRE role. We should call that out to the panel so scoring is consistent.

Jen: Agree on callout. Also suggest using the compact debrief template to speed things up. Quick paste: 
```
- Candidate: <name>
- Strengths (bullets)
- Risks / Concerns (bullets)
- Score (1-5)
- Primary area: [Infra / Prod / Tooling]
- Recommend: Hire / No-hire / Hold
```
If everyone fills that plus one-line rationale it's easy to roll up.

Anya: Good call. Can whoever is scribing add a one-line note about how they applied rubric 2.1 weighting for each candidate? That will help normalizing later.

Mike: Ok I moved off 09:00. 10:00 merged panel works for me. I can scribe for the merged 10:00 if Olivia wants to be free for prep.

Olivia: I actually prefer being on the interview. Mike, if you can scribe that'd be great — thanks.

People Ops Bot: Reminder — debrief form is at https://redwoodops/forms/debrief. Please submit within 45 minutes. :bell:

Anya: Final assignments: 
- 09:00: Jen, Rahul, Priya (scribe: Jen)
- 10:00 (merged A+C): Mike, Olivia, Samir, Casey (scribe: Mike)
Buffer: 15m between panels for quick score normalization.

Samir: Quick rubric note for scribe: for system-design questions mark "Primary area" accordingly and put the system-design score on the first line of Score rationale so it's visible.

Mike: Will do. I'll use Jen's compact template and add a short line: "Applied rubric2.1 weight = 40% to system-design" at top of each debrief.

Calendar Bot: Updated invites: Tue 09:00 (panel), Tue 10:00 (merged panel). 15m buffer added.

Anya: Thanks everyone — locking this. If anyone needs to swap, ping here and @people-ops. :pray: 

Jen: Quick follow-up — should we record a 2min note about interviewer calibration after panel 1? Might save time normalizing across panels.

Anya: Good idea. Let's add a 2-min calibration note at the top of merged panel 10:00 — scribe pls capture.

Mike: Noted. I'll add a "calibration note" header in the debrief doc.

People Ops Bot: Good luck to the interviewers! :clap:
